title: Simple message
description: A contact form on one screen, for a question, a supplier or a customer calling back. Name, phone, email and message.
keywords: contact, message, question, contact form, simple form

messages.success: Thank you {name}, your message has been sent. A copy has been sent to {email}.
messages.acknowledgement_body:
Hello {name},

Thank you for your message. Here is a copy of what you sent.
messages.success_no_copy: Thank you {name}, your message has been sent.
messages.privacy_notice: Your message is only used to answer you. It is saved on this website, sent to {site_name} by email and shared with no one else. It is kept {retention}. You can ask for a copy or for its deletion at any time.
